CHEST X-RAY REPORT

FINDINGS:
the cardiomediastinal silhouette is normal. the lung parenchyma is clear. there are no pleural or significant bony abnormalities.

IMPRESSION:
1. two views of the chest demonstrate a right upper extremity picc line with the distal tip at the cavoatrial junction. 2. cardiomediastinal silhouette is within normal limits. 3. there is a small left pleural effusion and left lower lobe atelectasis or consolidation. 4. there is a diffuse reticular pattern throughout the lungs, which may be chronic. 5. there is a dextroscoliosis of the thoracic spine.

raw_result.note: Probabilities range from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating higher likelihood of the condition.
